name: Email Health
query:
SELECT
	q.status AS "Status:Data:120",
	IFNULL(q.email_account, '') AS "Account:Data:200",
	LEFT(IFNULL(q.error, ''), 200) AS "Error:Data:520",
	COUNT(*) AS "Emails:Int:80",
	MAX(q.modified) AS "Last:Datetime:160"
FROM `tabEmail Queue` q FORCE INDEX (creation)
WHERE q.creation >= %(from_date)s AND q.creation < %(to_date)s + INTERVAL 1 DAY
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
ORDER BY 4 DESC
